Tosafot on Bava Batra 103b:2:1.hebrew: אם היה סלע יחידי אפי' כל שהוא כו' - פי' רבינו תם: סלע יחידי, היינו שיש לו שם לווי — סלע פלוני. הלכך אפי' הוי כל שהוא, ואפי' באמצע השדה, אין נמדד עמה. ועוד אומר רבינו תם דגרס: "שיש לו בית רובע", והכי איתא בירושלמי. וקאי אהא דאמרינן לעיל: "טרשין שאמרו — בית ד' קבין, והוא שלא יהו מובלעין בפחות מה' קבין". משמע: בפחות מד', אפילו מובלעין בפחות מה', נמדד עמה. והשתא קאמר: דאם היה סלע יחידי, שהכל סלע אחד, אפילו לא יהא גדול אלא בית רובע, דליכא ד' קבין, ואין אחרים נמי שיהו משלימין לארבע קבין — אפילו הכי אין נמדד עמה:
Tosafot on Bava Batra 103b:2:1.english: "If it was a single rock, even of any size," etc. - Rabbeinu Tam explained: a "single rock" means that it has a distinguishing name — "such-and-such rock." Therefore, even if it is of any size, and even if it is in the middle of the field, it is not measured together with it. Furthermore, Rabbeinu Tam says that the text reads: "that has an area of a *beit rova* (a quarter-kav)," and so it is in the Yerushalmi. And this refers to what we said above: "The rocky ground (*tarshin*) that they spoke of — [it must be] an area of four *kavim*, and provided that they are not enclosed within less than five *kavim*." This implies: [if it is] less than four, even if [the rocks] are enclosed within less than five, it is measured together with it. And now [the Baraita] says that if it was a single rock, meaning that the whole is one rock, even if it is no larger than a *beit rova*, so that there are not four *kavim*, and there are also no others that would complete it to four *kavim* — even so, it is not measured together with it.

Tosafot on Bava Batra 103b:4:1.hebrew: פחות כל שהוא ינכה - מה שפ"ה, דהא דאמר רבא: "כל דבר שבמדה, אפי' פחות מכדי אונאה חוזר" — היינו במטלטלי, אגב חורפיה לא עיין, דבהדיא אייתי לה בריש פ"ב דקידושין (דף מב: ושם) אמקרקעי, דאמר: "ובמקרקעי נמי לא אמרן אלא דטעו בעילויא, אבל במשחתא לא, כדרבא" כו'. ואור"י דרבא איירי כשמדדו והטעהו במדה, אבל הכא לא מדדו עדיין, אלא בבאין למדוד, ומתחלה היה נמי יודע שאינו מכוין כ"כ שלא יהא או פחות או יותר:
Tosafot on Bava Batra 103b:4:1.english: If it is less by any amount, he deducts - As for what Rashbam [explains], that Rava's statement, "For anything sold by measure, even [a discrepancy] less than the amount of ona'ah, he must return [the difference]," refers to movable goods — in his haste, he did not examine [the matter carefully], for [Rava's statement] is explicitly brought at the beginning of the second chapter of Kiddushin (42b there) with regard to land, where it says: "And with regard to land too, we said [this] only where they erred about the value, but not where they erred about the measurement, as Rava [said]," etc. And Rabbi Isaac answered that Rava is speaking where they measured and misled him in the measurement. But here they have not yet measured; rather, they are coming to measure, and from the outset he also knew that it would not be so exact that it would not be either less or more.

Tosafot on Bava Batra 103b:4:2.hebrew: פחות כל שהוא ינכה - וא"ת: ולימא ליה דאדעתא דהכי לא זבני? וי"ל: דקאי בתוך השדה, כדפרישית, דמתחילה היה נמי יודע שאינו מכוין לגמרי:
Tosafot on Bava Batra 103b:4:2.english: "If it is less, even by a small amount, he deducts" - And if you ask: Let [the buyer] say to [the seller], "I did not buy with this in mind"? And one can answer: [The case is] that [the buyer] is standing inside the field, as I explained, so that from the outset he also knew that it was not completely exact.
